claim_text:
Tomingley continues to explore renewable energy
solutions to provide an effective proportion of the
power requirements for the Tomingley processing
plant and other site infrastructure.
metric_name:
Renewable energy solution activity; 
diesel/electric hybrid underground mining equipment
context_text: During FY2025, a fleet of new diesel/electric hybrid underground mining equipment arrived on-site
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: claim具体指向探索可为Tomingley处理厂和现场基础设施供电的renewable energy solutions，但提供的证据仅是柴油/电动混合地下采矿设备到场，并不直接证明正在探索或实施可再生能源供电方案。因此证据与claim核心不匹配，不能作为有效支持。
